actions.reason: C0001 has strong coherent WXS identity evidence (PBRM1/VHL enrichment, large effect sizes, adjusted significance) and no technical confounder association. Cross-modal cohesion is weak and mixed, so structure remains uncertain, but no positive structural evidence supports split or merge and no available request could resolve this within budget; retain for downstream validation.

C0002 shows only weak, non-significant biological trends (DST, FLG, PIK3CA, chr8p/PTEN loss) and modest cross-modal cohesion, but no technical confounder association and no positive structural evidence for split or merge. It remains a defensible discovery-stage candidate with material uncertainty.

C0003 has very strong coherent WXS identity evidence (BAP1 enrichment, extreme effect size, adjusted significance) with wxs driving cross-modal cohesion and no technical confounder association. Structure is only moderate and remains uncertain, but no positive structural evidence supports revision; retain for downstream validation.

C0004 has significant WXS identity evidence (MUC16 enrichment) with wxs-driven cross-modal cohesion and no technical confounder association. MUC16 is a large gene prone to passenger mutations, so alternative explanation remains uncertain, but no positive structural evidence supports split or merge; retain with this caveat.

C0005 has only weak, non-significant biological evidence (nominal PBRM1 depletion) but shows the most broadly consistent cross-modal support with good resampling stability and no technical confounder association. No positive structural evidence supports revision; retain as a defensible but uncertain candidate.

Although C0006 has a coherent VHL/PBRM1-wildtype WXS signal, confounder analysis shows a significant scanner-model association (Sensation 64, q=0.018), providing a plausible technical explanation for the defining signal that cannot be excluded. This makes the candidate insufficiently defensible for retention.

C0007 has significant WXS identity evidence (ATM enrichment, large effect size) with perfect resampling stability and no technical confounder association. Small set size is a limitation, but no positive structural evidence supports revision; retain for downstream validation.

C0008 has only 2 members, precluding meaningful statistical inference; biological evidence is non-estimable, internal structure is non-estimable, and modality support is mixed with strongly negative wxs. The candidate is insufficiently defensible and no structural revision is indicated.
